coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded older grocery losses, historical/previously recorded pantry disruptions, old 2025 SNAP shutdown coverage, openings, donation and promotional stories, resource guides, policy changes without newly verified immediate impact.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying source-backed disruption was found between 23:48:29 PST Nov 9 and the completed_at timestamp Nov 10, using 12 bounded targeted searches and 9 direct source pages. One repeatedly inaccessible USDA page creates a nonmaterial coverage limitation.
